title: Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria
abstract: arXiv:2610.01356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with {one} attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a {product} of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.

translated_title: 面向具有多个渐近稳定平衡点系统的端口哈密顿神经网络
translated_abstract: 稳定端口哈密顿神经网络通过构造方式即可保证渐近稳定性。然而，其哈密顿函数是一个具有单一全局最小值的李雅普诺夫函数，因此只能表示仅有一个吸引子的动态系统。我们证明这一限制甚至排除了具有双井能量地形的简单系统。为克服这一限制，我们提出将哈密顿函数参数化为由一个输入凸网络生成的Bregman散度的乘积。我们证明所得到的模型是局部李雅普诺夫稳定的，稳定平衡点的共存必然会迫使额外的非渐近稳定平衡点存在，所有平衡点都位于一个有界区域内，并且在双曲性假设下几乎处处稳定。在三个系统上的实验表明，我们的方法能够恢复能量面特征，并将收敛速度提升1.8倍至8.5倍。
tldr: 提出将端口哈密顿神经网络的哈密顿函数参数化为由单一输入凸网络生成的Bregman散度乘积，使其能够表示具有多个渐近稳定平衡点的系统，并从理论上证明了局部李雅普诺夫稳定性等性质，同时将收敛速度提升1.8至8.5倍。
en_tdlr: This paper parametrizes the Hamiltonian of port-Hamiltonian neural networks as a product of Bregman divergences generated by a single input-convex network, enabling the representation of systems with multiple asymptotically stable equilibria, with theoretical guarantees of local Lyapunov stability and convergence speed improvements of 1.8×–8.5×.
